 lastLog[p]=os.clock(); Log.Log(p,reason)

end

 return true
end

 if not root or target.X~=target.X or target.Y~=target.Y or target.Z~=target.Z then return false end

 return true

 if p.Character then p.Character:PivotTo(cf);previous[p]=cf.Position end

  p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() previous[p]=nil;exempt[p]=os.clock()+5 end)

end

   if old and (not valid(old.data) or (old.lock and old.lock.expires>os.time())) then return nil end
   return {data=if old then old.data else fresh(),lock={token=token,expires=os.time()+120}}
  end)
 end)
